title: Carpet deodoriser powder
subtitle: A bicarbonate and essential oil powder for freshening carpets and rugs
excerpt: A dry powder of bicarbonate of soda and essential oils scattered over carpets and rugs, left for 30 minutes to absorb odours, then vacuumed up. Lavender and tea tree provide a fresh scent and some antimicrobial action. Makes about 200 g of powder, enough for several applications over a large room. Shelf life 6 months.
sourceNotes: Bicarbonate of soda (sodium bicarbonate) as an odour absorber: reacts with acidic and basic volatile organic compounds, converting them to odourless salts. Effective at absorbing pet odours (amines from urine), food smells, and general carpet mustiness. No perfume-masking function, it neutralises odour compounds directly. Arrowroot or cornflour added at 10-20%: helps the bicarb flow more evenly and prevents clumping in humid environments. Lavender EO + tea tree EO: fragrance and antimicrobial. Essential oil distribution: add drops to the dry powder and stir thoroughly; the bicarb absorbs the EO and releases it slowly. Caveat: do not use on wet carpet or damp areas, bicarb will cake and leave residue.

recipe.yieldDescription: ~200 g powder (6-8 applications for a medium room)
recipe.batchNotes: Make in 200-400 g batches and store in a wide-mouth jar with a shaker lid. A 400 g batch is a 3-month supply for weekly use on one room.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Ready immediately once mixed. Store in an airtight jar between uses.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: 6 months in an airtight jar. Essential oils fade over time; the bicarb itself remains effective indefinitely. The powder clumps if exposed to moisture, discard if it no longer flows freely.

glossaryTerms.definition: Bicarbonate of soda neutralises acidic and basic odour compounds (like urine amines or sweat acids) by reacting with them chemically, producing odourless salts, rather than masking them with fragrance.

content.text: Combine the bicarbonate of soda and cornflour in a bowl and stir to mix.
Add the essential oils and stir thoroughly until the oil droplets are absorbed into the powder. No liquid spots should remain visible.
Transfer to a jar. To use: sprinkle liberally over dry carpet, leave for 30 minutes, then vacuum thoroughly.
